script_text: This week, Aries, your ruling planet Mars squares Pluto in your 11th House, igniting your fire before a dramatic shift. Thursday marks the turning point as the Sun enters Scorpio to activate your 8th House of shared money, while Mars trines Saturn in your 12th House, grounding your drive. Late week, Venus in Scorpio deepens romantic bonds. A weekend Venus-Mars trine favors passion. Wednesday is your power day. Tuesday is your worst day due to the Mars-Pluto square. Review finances before Friday, trust your intuition. Follow for daily updates.
